# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Every morning you wake up, a battle is already waiting. Not against flesh and blood, but against apathy, compromise, and the quiet pull to coast through another day. Joshua faced the same tension. Moses was dead, the Jordan stood in front of him, and the promise of God seemed impossibly far away. God's command wasn't "feel brave." It was "be strong and courageous"—a decision of the will, rooted in the promise that God Himself goes with you. Courage isn't the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of fear. As men of Christ, we don't wait until we feel ready. We rise, we take the ground God has given us, and we trust His presence more than our circumstances. Whatever you're facing today—a hard conversation, a temptation, a task you've been avoiding—step into it with God at your side. He has not left you, and He will not fail you. Battle the day, brother. You don't fight alone.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and on each rep thank God that He is with you wherever you go.
